rival.sentence_T2: T2: 8/8 non-semantic and 3/4 semantic perturbation rows with >=10 correct non-Dijkstra programs are majority BF_SPFA (random directions included): perturbations of every kind land on the runner-up.
rival.sentence_T1: T1: only 2 non-ban perturbation rows leave BFS with >=10 correct programs (0/0 non-semantic and 1/2 semantic are majority DFS); generic perturbations rarely leave BFS while bans land on DFS.

predict_gated.gating_note: the literal gate also admits exp1's nine bans of absent modes (avoidance ~1 by construction, realised samples are the default mode); they are excluded from the contest as uninformative (exp1/results/event_table.json marks them informative=false)
predict_gated.rule: a family advances only if its calibrated mean log score beats the next best by >= 0.10 nats on >= 3 events where top-1 nominations disagree
predict_gated.outcome: no family can advance under the rule
predict_gated.smoothing: 5% uniform over survivors, 2% 'other' floor, applied to every family identically

unforecast.exp3: no family forecasts (fork/locus screen): its G2 ban events are unforecast
unforecast.exp6: forecasts are claim-type predictions P1-P8 (results/analysis.json#forecast_check), not family distributions over survivors

exp4_preregistration_rules_verbatim.S_flat: rarefied hill1_cc(dc at c*_t) - hill1_cc(HF c=0) has a paraphrase-cluster bootstrap 90% CI above 0 on both tasks ('partial' if on one); c*_t must be correctness-preserving (pass >= 0.8 x pass(c=0)).
exp4_preregistration_rules_verbatim.S_specific: that gain exceeds each random direction's gain at c*_t (paired cluster-bootstrap 90% CI of rarefied hill1(dc) - hill1(rand_k) above 0, k=1,2), and also the placebo's when E1 ran.
exp4_preregistration_rules_verbatim.S_vs_prompt: dc at c*_t against enumerate and ban:X_t (efficiency = delta_hill/delta_pass_pts, CIs); 'best knob' only if the 90% CIs separate.
exp4_preregistration_rules_verbatim.overall: ADVANCE if S_flat and S_specific hold on >= 1 task with the same sign (point estimate of delta_hill > 0) on the other; PARTIAL if S_flat holds without S_specific; DROP if S_flat fails at every correctness-preserving c of every task that has one; INCONCLUSIVE if no task has a correctness-preserving c.
exp4_preregistration_rules_verbatim.PREDICT: log-score ranks and top-1 hits of the hash-committed forecasts, reported as a forecast record with no threshold.

buy.operational_rule: BUY (exp4 S_vs_prompt): efficiency = delta_hill / delta_pass_pts with CIs; 'best knob' only if the 90% CIs separate. Recomputed here with the one-statistic knob table (compliant-only rarefied Hill-1 at depth 25).

T1.scope: diversity knobs and bans only (named-mode cues, model swaps and the gen-then-select ceiling excluded)

T2.scope: diversity knobs and bans only (named-mode cues, model swaps and the gen-then-select ceiling excluded)

seeds.double_dissociation: On T1 the semantic seed moves the read-position state toward the implied mode (cosine 0.493, exp6 analysis) yet behaviour moves +5.0 points; on T2 the cosine is -0.087 yet behaviour moves +61.0 points toward BF_SPFA. Activation shift and behavioural shift dissociate in both directions, so the read-position subspace picture does not predict behaviour.

exp2_deviations: Generation engine: vLLM 0.32 could not start (Triton needs a C compiler; the container has none), so every phase samples with batched HF transformers generate (bf16, sdpa, left padding, identical token ids). Sampling noise is seeded per batch (torch.manual_seed) instead of per request.
Hardware: one NVIDIA L4 (23 GB, ~300 GB/s), 6 CPUs, 57 GB RAM (cgroup) instead of the planned RTX A4500.

Elicitation prompt: a final line "Remember: answer with only the JSON list of approach names, not code." was appended after the task spec, because the spec itself ends by asking for a python code block.

HF sampling uses chunked continuation in Phases A and C: rows still running after 448 new tokens are resumed (prompt + partial output) in a later batch, up to 1024 tokens in total. This is the same model distribution but a different random stream; truncation at 1024 counts as a failure.

Phase D generates in one round (max_new_tokens 768, batch 25, per-row stop at the closing fence) so that common random numbers hold across arms: identical batch composition and order, torch.manual_seed(1000+b).
Realised mode = the most frequent compliant label leading the runner-up by >= 15 percentage points of the compliant samples (compliant = passes the hidden tests and is not a banned label).
Tied forecasts (e.g. a uniform frequency nomination when every survivor has 0 baseline count) are recorded as tied and excluded from top-1 hit counts; they are still scored by log score.

t1: R gate failed at l*=27 (named 0.99 vs null95 0.20; transfer 0.67 vs null95 0.22; decoder JS 0.722 vs null p5 0.175). Geometry and C3 are reported descriptively with the flag 'R gate failed'; best named log-likelihood layer = 28.
Layer choice: named-only probe accuracy saturates because the algorithm name is in context, so l* is the argmax of named->masked transfer accuracy (as pre-declared).
t1: removal variant = R-plus-prompt (prompt suffix incl. R only); held-out d_X AUC at R (l*=27) = 0.891, best generated-position AUC = 0.657 (pre-declared rule: both < 0.9 -> R-plus-prompt).
t1: pre-declared alpha escalation triggered (moved 0/8 at alpha=1.0, pass 1.00 vs 1.00); alpha=2.0 added.
t2: removal variant = R-plus-prompt (prompt suffix incl. R only); held-out d_X AUC at R (l*=24) = 0.789, best generated-position AUC = 0.762 (pre-declared rule: both < 0.9 -> R-plus-prompt).
t2: pre-declared alpha escalation triggered (moved 0/8 at alpha=1.0, pass 1.00 vs 1.00); alpha=2.0 added.
Dropped (pre-declared drop order 1 and 5): the optional external-model elicitation and the LOCO distribution decoder; the three simple gate tests were kept.

Forced manipulation check below 50% for T2 bidir_dijkstra (0.33) and dial (0.37): both modes are flagged, and results/manipulation_sensitivity.json recomputes their centroids from the paraphrases whose forced sample was labelled X (sensitivity only; the committed forecasts are unchanged).

Present-minor strata are empty on both tasks (the baselines are 200/200 BFS and 200/200 Dijkstra), so the only primary ban events are the two modal bans; frequency nominations are uniform over the survivors (tied) and are therefore excluded from top-1 hit counts.

Exploratory extension (after Phase D): step-2 ban sets {modal + each of the two most frequent compliant labels under ban:modal} were sampled at N=50 although the pre-declared succession rule stopped at the modal-ban failure (< 50% compliance). Their forecasts were committed in Phase B; they are reported separately from the primary events. The optional mention:modal arm (N=50/task) was also sampled here.

EXPLORATORY removal arms (post hoc, after the pre-declared R-plus-prompt arms): full affine variant editing the prompt suffix and every generated position (d_X_gen, generated anchors) at alpha 2 and 4 plus a random control at alpha 4, N=25 each, sharing the first common-random-number batch with the hooked alpha=0 arm. Reported separately; not part of the pre-declared C2 verdict.

gpu_hours.rule: per GPU-phase log file (name matches gen|state|steer|vllm|hf|gpu|phase|run_|acts|engine), first and last timestamp; the union of these spans per experiment (overlapping logs of one phase counted once). Upper bound on GPU-busy time (includes waits); exp1 has no GPU-phase log file under logs/ (not extracted).
